dependencyInventory.reason: Core 0.1.0-alpha.1 ships no separately packaged optional adapter bundle; AI/Git/cloud adapters remain outside Core.

P13-01.reason: CI action refs and permission scopes can be mechanically audited.

P13-02.reason: PR/main CI has no publication credentials and uses least-privilege permissions.

P13-03.reason: No OIDC/trusted npm publishing identity is configured.

P13-04.reason: Provenance exists for the publish-equivalent artifact, but there is no externally published OpenContainer release/package identity yet.

P13-05.reason: SPDX 2.3 SBOM is digest-bound to the exact release tarball.

P13-06.reason: Release manifest/provenance bind commit, lock, exact toolchain, environment and artifact digests.

P13-07.reason: Current CI builds clean ephemeral checkouts by commit, not an immutable release tag.

P13-08.reason: The exact reproducible tarball digest in release evidence must equal the distribution-certification artifact digest that passed SDK/examples/hosting/privacy courts.

P13-09.reason: No cryptographic signing/keyless attestation identity is produced for downloadable bundles.

P13-10.reason: No trusted signature/keyless attestation verification can exist before P13-09.

P13-11.reason: SHA-256/SHA-512 checksums are independently emitted and mechanically verified.

P13-12.reason: Inventory is generated from the installed production artifact; current optional adapter bundle count is explicitly zero.

P13-13.reason: Inventory separates runtime direct/transitive, optional adapters and source dev/test-only dependencies.

P13-14.reason: Distribution staging fails closed on test namespaces, env/git/github/secret/private-corpus paths, private keys, API-key patterns and host-local paths.

P13-15.reason: Two independent staging builds must match SHA-256, SHA-512 and byte size.

P13-16.reason: No real package registry staging/canary publication exists yet.

P13-17.reason: Repository branch/tag/release protection settings are external GitHub state and are not yet certified.

P13-18.reason: No retained OpenSSF Scorecard/OSPS Baseline receipt exists yet.

P13-19.reason: P17 exercises compromised-publishing-credential revocation, rebuild and consumer-warning actions.

P13-20.reason: 90-day CI artifacts are retained, but long-term historical verification storage policy is not yet closed.
